sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Slaves to Darkness army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Slaves to Darkness units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero's origin and/or flaw.
5. Choose a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be. Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Aspiring Champion | 15 | 150
Aspiring Lord | 35 | 250
Exalted Lord | 55 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 3 - Choose an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
Chaos Lord
-4DP
Change your hero's Save characteristic to 3+. Change their Chaos Blade to the following characteristics:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Chaos Blade
Crit (Mortal) | 5 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
In addition, your hero gains the WARRIORS OF CHAOS keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SLAVES TO DARKNESS units
Chaos Sorcerer Lord
-2DP
Your hero gains the WARRIORS OF CHAOS and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SLAVES TO DARKNESS units
Darkoath Warleader
0DP
Your hero gains the DARKOATH keyword and the following ability and regiment options:
Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
OATH OF SUPREMACY
Effect: If this unit is wholly within enemy territory and charged this phase, for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly DARKOATH units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Regiment Options | Any DARKOATH units
Ogroid Brute
-2DP
Change your hero’s Move characteristic to 6" and Health characteristic to 8. Your hero gains the following ability and regiment options:
Passive
MYRMIDON RAGE
Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
Regiment Options | Any SLAVES TO DARKNESS units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-2DP
BETRAYED BY THE FALSE GOD
Effect: You can re-roll hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target enemy ORDER units.
Any Combat Phase
-4DP
VICTOR OF 100 DUELS
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse this unit’s challenge:
Accept: For the rest of the phase, when this unit and the target are picked to use a FIGHT ability, all of their attacks must target the other unit. In addition, for the rest of the phase, you can re-roll hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
Refuse: The target cannot use FIGHT abilities for the rest of the phase. In addition, you gain 1 command point.
Your Movement Phase
-2DP
THE BRINGER OF FIRE
Declare: Pick a terrain feature that has not yet been set ablaze within this HERO’S combat range to be the target.
Effect: That terrain feature is now set ablaze. Add 1 to this unit’s control score for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative). In addition, for the rest of the battle, each time a unit (friend or enemy) ends a move within 3" of a terrain feature that has been set ablaze, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+2DP
RECKLESS ARROGANCE
Effect: This unit cannot use the’ All-out Defence’ command.
Passive, WARRIORS OF CHAOS or DARKOATH only MORTAL only
+2DP
SPURNED BY THE GODS
Effect: This unit cannot be picked as a target for the’ Eye of the Gods’ ability.
Your Hero Phase
+4DP
RAMPANT MUTATION
Effect: This unit must use this ability in each of your hero phases. Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect until the start of your next turn:
1 | Rotting Skin: Inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit. Subtract 1 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
2 | Brittle Scales: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target this unit.
3 | Bestial Tongue: You lose 1 command point. This unit cannot use commands.
4 | Sprouting Tentacles: This unit’s Move characteristic is 2D6".
5 | Extra Eyeball: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
6 | Erupting Spikes: Each time this unit finishes a pile-in move, pick an enemy unit within l" of this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
DAEMONIC STEED: These fierce mounts are often granted to Chaos Lords by their patron. In battle, enemies that are not felled by the rider’s weapons are trampled into the dirt by the wild thrashing of this beast’s mighty hooves.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Daemonic Steed’s Mighty Hooves
Companion | 3 | 5+ | 3+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Battle Mount
-10DP
CHAOS CHARIOT: Tribal war leaders often ride to war upon these darkiron constructs, pulled into battle by a pair of Chaos Steeds.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Chaos Steeds' Trampling Hooves
Companion | 4 | 5+ | 3+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 10.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the WAR MACHINE keyword.
Battle Mount
-20DP
MIGHTY CHAOTIC BEAST: Terrifying reptilian beasts prowl the chaotic wastes of the Eightpoints. For most, encountering one of these colossal creatures means a swift and painful death. Only those truly courting the gaze of the Dark Gods can hope to bend such a creature to their will.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Mighty Chaotic Beast's Talons
Companion | 6 | 4+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Chaotic Beast’s Talons is 4.
In addition, make the following changes and add the following abilities:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 14.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.

sections.name: Step 6 - Battle Mount Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Daemonic Speed
-2DP
Add 2" to your hero's Move characteristic.
Stubborn Beast
-4DP
MONSTER only. Add 2 to your hero’s Health characteristic.
Winged Beast
-4DP
CAVALRY or MONSTER only. Your hero gains the FLY keyword.
Razor-likeTalons
-4DP
MONSTER only. Your hero’s Mighty Chaotic Beast’s Talons have a Damage characteristic of 3.
Gorebeast Chariot
-2DP
WAR MACHINE only. Your hero’s Chaos Steeds’ Trampling Hooves is replaced with the following melee weapon:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Gorebeast's Crushing Fists
Companion | 4 | 4+ | 4+ | - | 2
Carve a Bloody Path
-4DP
MONSTER or WAR MACHINE only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
CARVE A BLOODY PATH
Effect: When this unit uses the’ Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3+1 mortal damage on the target and add 3" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE
Blood of Molten Varanite
-3DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
BLOOD OF MOLTEN VARANITE
Effect: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

sections.name: Step 7 - Pick any Other Upgrades
sections.text:
Pick any number of other upgrades for your hero. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.

Blasphemous Fortitude

INFANTRY only. Add 1 to your hero’s Health characteristic.
Weapon Master
-3DP
The Hit characteristic of your hero’s Chaos Blade is 3+.
Diabolic Strength
-3DP
The Wound characteristic of your hero’s Chaos Blade is 2+.
Favoured Foe
-3DP
Your hero’s Chaos Blade has Anti-X (+1 Rend), where X is 1 of the following keywords: INFANTRY, CAVALRY, MONSTER, WAR MACHINE, WIZARD or PRIEST.
Fearsome Charger
-4DP
CAVALRY, WAR MACHINE or MONSTER only. Your hero’s Chaos Blade has Charge (+1 Damage).
Daemon-bound Blade
-4DP
Your hero’s Chaos Blade has Crit (Mortal).
Battle Ferocity
-5DP
Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of your hero’s Chaos Blade.
Blood-fuelled Menace
-4DP
Your hero has the following ability:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
BLOOD-FUELLED MENACE
Effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
Glimpse the Future
-4DP
Your hero has the following ability:
Deployment Phase

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-4, the result corresponds to the battle round in which this unit will be inspired. On a 5+, pick a number. The number you picked corresponds to the battle round in which this unit will be inspired. While this unit is inspired, it has STRIKE-FIRST.
The Grandfather's Blessing
-2DP
Your hero has the following ability:
Start of Any Turn
THE GRANDFATHER'S BLESSING
Effect: Heal (D3) this unit.
The Thrill of Battle
-2DP
Your hero has the following ability:
Passive
THE THRILL OF BATTLE
Effect: Each time you make a charge roll for this unit, for each dice that was an unmodified 6, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle. Units can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

sections.name: Path of The Dark Champion
sections.text:
(SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
MARKED FOR GREATNESS
Effect: This unit has WARD (6+). In addition, each time an unmodified ward roll of 6 is made for this unit, Heal (1) this unit.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
DAEMONIC PACT
Effect: Roll a D3. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on this unit equal to the roll. Then, pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons and add the result to its Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Any Combat Phase
NOT TO BE DENIED
Effect: If this unit is within 6" of any enemy units but not in combat, this unit can make a move of D6".
Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
DARK IMMORTALITY
Declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 6, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
MOLTEN GOREBLADE
Effect: Each time a hit roll for a combat attack made for this unit scores a critical hit, you can pick an enemy unit within 8" of this unit to be the target. If you do so, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that FIGHT ability has been resolved.
Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
EXHILARATING SPEED
Effect: Change one of the dice in the charge roll to a 6.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BOUNTIFUL FLESH
Effect: Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
Deployment Phase
FATED CHAMPION
Effect: Roll 3 dice. During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for this unit, you can spend 1 of these dice. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the dice you spend:
Hit rolls
Wound rolls
Save rolls

sections.text:
(non-HERO SLAVES TO DARKNESS unit only)

Your Hero Phase
ASPIRING WARRIORS
Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has WARD (6+).

Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
Passive
BULWARKS OF BLACK IRON
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
FERRIUM PLATE
Effect: Each phase, the first damage point inflicted on this unit is ignored.

BRINGERS OF RUIN

LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, they gain the following ability:
Deployment Phase
GODMARKED WARRIORS
